title: Knowledge Graph Reconciler
short: Match your extracted entities against Google's Knowledge Graph, and flag the ones where the returned type contradicts the type your content implies.
needs: The same Google key, with the Knowledge Graph Search API also enabled
inputs: entity_mentions.csv from the Extractor, or a pasted list
outputs: kg_reconciliation.csv — matched, ambiguous, unmatched, with type conflicts flagged
how: Paste your key and upload the entity export.
Leave the match-score floor at 20 unless you have a reason to change it.
Read the three verdicts before you read a single row.
Filter to type conflicts — those are matches that are confidently wrong.
Export, and keep the file for the Scorecard.
note: A returned match is not a correct match. Check the type and the description before you trust the score.
